verdicts.reason: Both are the same mostly scaled layout: quote, attribution and can are placed as in the original. Both leave a dead band in the middle left of the canvas, and the can sits off-centre in an enlarged bleed circle, so the layout looks shrunk rather than rearranged for the new shape. The only visible difference is the bottom-left logo. A keeps the original's mixed glyph sizes at a proportional scale. B's logo is oversized and its glyphs look evened out, so its shapes no longer match the original, which makes A slightly more faithful to the brand.
